default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win19cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win19cis_rule_1_2_4 }}
command:
  win19cis_1_2_4_resetlockoutcount:
    title: "1.2.4 | Ensure 'Reset account lockout counter after' is set to '15 or more minute(s)' | ResetLockoutCount"
    exec: |-
      powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p = Join-Path '{{ .Vars.win19cis_snapshot_dir }}' 'SystemAccess.ResetLockoutCount'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { 'NONCOMPLIANT not_collected' } else { $r = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($r -notmatch '^[0-9]+$') { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $r } else { $v = [int]$r; if ($v -ge {{ .Vars.win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset }}) { 'COMPLIANT' } else { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $v } } }"
    exit-status: 0
    stdout:
      - '/^COMPLIANT$/'
    stderr:
      have-len: 0
    timeout: {{ .Vars.timeout_ms }}
    skip: {{ if eq .Vars.win19cis_system_role "standalone" }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.2.4
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-7
        - AC-19
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_1/section_1.2.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_1/section_1.2.x/cis_1.2.4.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (when: (win19cis_rule_1_2_1 and win19cis_account_lockout_duration >= 15) or discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int == 0 or win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset <= discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.2.4 | PATCH | Ensure Reset account lockout counter after is set to 15 or more minutes"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_1_2_4
    - not prelim_win19cis_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_1.2.4
    - patch
    - account
    - NIST800-171_3.1.8
    - NIST800-171_3.1.18
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-19
  block:
    - name: "1.2.4 | PATCH | Ensure Reset account lockout counter after is set to 15 or more minutes | Set Variable"
      when:
        - win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset >= 15
        - win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset <= win19cis_account_lockout_duration
        - (win19cis_rule_1_2_1 and win19cis_account_lockout_duration >= 15) or
          discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int == 0 or
          win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset <= discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: ResetLockoutCount
        value: "{{ win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset }}"

    - name: "1.2.4 | AUDIT | Ensure Reset account lockout counter after is set to 15 or more minutes | Warn that the current lockout duration blocks the reset counter"
      when:
        - not (win19cis_rule_1_2_1 and win19cis_account_lockout_duration >= 15)
        - discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int != 0
        - win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset > discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset ({{ win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset }}) is greater than the current"
          - "Account lockout duration ({{ discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) }}) and 1.2.1 is not applying a new duration."
          - "Windows rejects a reset counter above the duration, so 1.2.4 was not applied. Enable 1.2.1 or raise the duration."

    - name: "1.2.4 | AUDIT | Ensure Reset account lockout counter after is set to 15 or more minutes | Warn that the current lockout duration blocks the reset counter | Set warning count"
      when:
        - not (win19cis_rule_1_2_1 and win19cis_account_lockout_duration >= 15)
        - discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int != 0
        - win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset > discovered_win19cis_current_lockout_duration | default(0) | int
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '1.2.4'

    - name: "1.2.4 | AUDIT | Ensure Reset account lockout counter after is set to 15 or more minutes | Verify variable set to 15 or more minutes warning"
      when:
        - win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset > win19cis_account_lockout_duration or
          win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset < 15
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of minutes set for win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "1.2.4 | AUDIT | Ensure Reset account lockout counter after is set to 15 or more minutes | Set warning count"
      when:
        - win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset > win19cis_account_lockout_duration or
          win19cis_account_lockout_counter_reset < 15
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '1.2.4'
